evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce VideoACE, a benchmark for assessing video understanding under conditions that support sustained interaction.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark comprises 1,000 multiple-choice questions spanning six categories of fine-grained action understanding, accompanied by temporal evidence annotations and user hints screened for answer leakage.
